release_name: Live TV v3.4 — Phone Remote, Audio Profiles & Pro Features
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 📱 Phone as TV Remote: Scan QR code to control Live TV wirelessly from your phone on Wi-Fi (zero install)
🪟 True System Picture-in-Picture (PiP): Pop out video into native floating corner overlay (Shortcut P)
📊 Broadcast Diagnostics HUD: Real-time 'Stats for Nerds' telemetry showing resolution, fps, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames (Shortcut I)
🎚️ Pro Audio Equalizer: 5 acoustic presets (Normal, 🏟️ Stadium Sports, 🎙️ Dialogue Clarity, 🌙 Night Mode, 🎵 Music)
⏱️ Bedtime Sleep Timer: 15/30/45/60/90/120 min countdown with smooth 2-minute audio fade-out
➕ Custom Stream & M3U Importer: Add single .m3u8 stream links or batch import IPTV playlists with persistent storage
⚡ One-Click Native In-App Auto-Updater with live progress and automatic relaunch
Added Discovery Bangla, Discovery Kids Bangla, Discovery Science HD, Discovery Turbo HD
2,989 total live channels with 3-server instant auto-failover
